newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares up in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares up in Beirut.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares rose on Monday on increased turnover on the privately-operated Beirut Secondary Market (BSM).
A shares -- distributed to former holders of property rights in the Beirut central district SOLIDERE is rebuilding -- rose to $105.5 from $105.25 on Friday.
B shares -- issued in a $650-million subscription in January 1994 -- also rose to 107.0 from $106.5.
Turnover on BSM, which trades only SOLIDERE shares, rose to 9,351 shares from Friday's 7,066 and value was $995,221 from $746,591.
There was no trade on the Beirut Stock Exchange (BSE) in any of the listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
On Friday, 200 shares were traded at $1.25.
The BLOM Stock Index which covers both markets rose 0.27 percent to 914.42 and the LISPI index also rose 0.10 percent to 82.33.
